summary: Iteration 2 retest: backend whitelist/409 + frontend cookie auth bootstrap, full session/profile/wizard/trip-form/preview/finish/temperature/Warehouse-Water flows verified end-to-end.

minor.issue: No Pydantic validation of payload (raw Dict[str,Any]) — accepts arbitrary fields; intentionally deferred per main agent.

issues: React/Radix console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description / aria-describedby' on profile, finish, preview, continue, wizard dialogs. Accessibility-only, no functional impact.

action_items: Optional: add Pydantic models to /api/profile and /api/trip-sessions create payloads instead of Dict[str, Any].
Optional accessibility: add DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) and DialogDescription to all DialogContent components to silence Radix warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/trip-sessions/{id} now correctly whitelists fields (rows, road_expenses, notes, order_number, bol_number, truck_number) and 409s on finished sessions. Verified user_id, finished_at, _id, session_id, created_at cannot be mutated by client.
POST /api/trip-sessions/{id}/finish correctly returns 404 on missing and 409 on already-finished sessions.
CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env is now an explicit list (frontend prod URL + localhost), allowing credentials properly with axios withCredentials:true.

Frontend axios instance uses withCredentials:true; cookie-based auth verified by Playwright cookie injection — Dashboard renders at /dashboard, profile bootstrap, session wizard and trip form all functional.
test_credentials: Mongo-injected session_token. Test users: test_session_1777581078228 (api tests), test_fe_session_1777581128834 (browser tests).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 test users + sessions in test_database (users + user_sessions collections). Created Warehouse-Water active trip-session ORDWW-1 / BOLWW-1 via API for FE test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers root, auth/me (unauth+bearer), profile save/get, trip-session create/active/get/PUT-whitelist/finish/finish-404/finish-409/PUT-on-finished-409, and learning bumps for locations/trailers/cities. Run with TEST_SESSION_TOKEN env var. For UI auth, inject session_token as cookie (httpOnly, secure, sameSite=None, path=/) on driver-sheets-1.preview.emergentagent.com; backend reads it via get_current_user. Row toggle sometimes needs 1 click after wizard close to expand — normal expand/collapse behavior. Temperature stepper: row-N-temp testid is on the display <div>, not an <input>; use the +/- sibling buttons.
rca of the issue: Iter 1 dashboard didn't render after cookie injection because backend allow_origins='*' is invalid with allow_credentials=True (browsers reject the response, axios withCredentials:true fails, /auth/me 401s, ProtectedRoute redirects to /). Fix: explicit origin list in CORS_ORIGINS now allows credentials. Verified end-to-end this iteration.
